The boiler_direct-contact example (efficiency 98%, emissions-reduction potential 70%) feeds this archetype by design: boiler_direct-contact was absorbed into it on 2026-10-05 (OG14), so no re-map.

Section 1 rule 5 (one-bound values kept as low or high) now gives every one: drilling-rig_electric emissions-reduction-potential high 100, flare abatement-cost co2e low 64.7, well_in-situ-oxy-combustion efficiency high 98 and emissions-reduction-potential high 70; the build has no sourced row with no central, low or high.

Rule scope change (records/fill/fill-rule.csv), since a rule fills every one of these cells so a judgement would be displaced: (1) est-sibling-capacity-factor: add exclude-archetype=turboexpander_ngl-recovery (its sibling is turboexpander_pressure-let-down, 38%, a let-down machine running on spare pressure). (2) est-class-capacity-factor: add exclude-archetype=turboexpander_ngl-recovery|adsorber_molecular-sieve|pump_electric-station|pump_plunger-lift|pump_artificial-lift|drilling-rig_diesel|drilling-rig_electric|drilling-rig_battery-hybrid|fracturing-fleet_electric (rotating-equipment class median 60% and all-archetype fallback 90%). (3) est-end-use-capacity-factor cannot fill them: gas-processing has one sourced value (gas-treatment-unit_sulphur-recovery 95, per t, not per m3). Then add draft judgements: turboexpander_ngl-recovery and adsorber_molecular-sieve 95 (88-98), the gas-treatment-unit siblings' value; pump_electric-station 90 (75-97) for mainline throughput; pump_artificial-lift and pump_plunger-lift 90 (75-97), a lifted well runs whenever it produces; drilling-rig_diesel, _electric, _battery-hybrid and fracturing-fleet_electric 50 (40-60), CAODC rig utilisation. Caution: the drilling-rig annual-output judgement (100,000 m/yr) already counts about 25 wells drilled in a working year; with a 50% capacity factor the annual output identity would halve it, so restate that judgement as nameplate (about 200,000 m/yr) or leave annual output as drafted.

Build check (pipeline/checks.py or reports.py): for every archetype whose product is t CH4 or t CO2, report cost-levelized calculated / abatement-cost (same species) beside coverage and flag ratios outside 0.2-5. The OG003 unmapping removes the EPA pipeline rows from compressor_flare-gas-recovery (capex 3856 -> 1500); separator_reduced-emission-completion (25x low) and compressor_low-emission-seal (6.5x high) need the check's trace before any row change.

No row change: the drafted 700 t CO2/yr is close to the EPA 2023 representative oil-well flare (tp-epa_2023_002-0478, 326 short tons CH4/yr destroyed, about 800-1100 t CO2/yr with the heavier hydrocarbons), and the flare capex 300 CAD per t/yr agrees with epa_2023_001 (USD 100,579 per flare) and icf_2015_001 (CAD 94,050) at that size. The finding's 7,000-70,000 t/yr is a gas-plant or battery flare. Ask Brad which flare the CIMS flaring node represents; if a gas-plant flare, scale annual output to about 10,000 t/yr and capex to about 30 CAD per t/yr together.
